title: Settled application requirements
summary: Tailor strong, readable resumes to JD work; tool retrofit is authorized. Preserve employers/dates. All four employers, max four bullets each, no eight-total cap; relevant independent project; one or two pages without deleting useful content to force one. Jev decides/checks; writers create.
body: Canonical tool inventory is intentionally incomplete. Do not ask for exhaustive freelance/tool lists or reopen employer-specific tool verification. Do not invent companies, dates, metrics or repository URLs. No minimum-word evaluation loops. Skills separate concrete tools from methods/domains. Child checks precede parent checks. One initial writer request with separately owned blocks was recommended in the follow-up, not independently proven superior. Original JD, resolved source text and explicit options must reach each decision/writing unit.
change_reason: Initial migration: preserve source context and current user intent
